title: Blank input halts the guard scan
statement: For any natural number $b$, Boolean input string $x$, natural number $u$, and Boolean output string $out$, one step of the guard machine with parameter $b$, started in phase $u$ at the right blank cell of $x$ with output $out$, yields the configuration in the halting state at that same cell, with output unchanged.
